title: Kinde OAuth Authentication
outcome: Use Kinde OAuth with PKCE flow via @plantquest/kinde-auth-pkce-js for authentication. Dual-layer auth with Kinde + Seneca backend.
rationale: Enterprise-grade OAuth 2.0 with PKCE security. Centralized user management, long-lived refresh tokens, automatic token refresh, role-based access, multi-device support.

risk.acceptance: External dependency on Kinde service. Vendor lock-in but acceptable tradeoff for security and user management features. Migration to other OAuth provider possible but requires refactoring.

security_considerations: XSS Protection: HttpOnly cookies prevent JavaScript access
CSRF Protection: State parameter validation in PKCE flow
Token Theft: Short-lived access tokens with long-lived refresh tokens
Replay Attacks: PKCE code verifier prevents reuse
Man-in-the-Middle: HTTPS required for all communication
